title: Two same-wave attempts rewriting the same function's exit logic collide without git ever flagging it
description:
4mv and bot both rewrote how watch decides its exit code in the same wave; the merge machinery saw a conflict only where lines overlapped textually (exit.go, README), while watch.go merged cleanly-but-wrong, and only bot's tests at the integrated gate caught it. The cost was a resolve job, a person's settle (decision 13) and a re-dispatch. A claim-time touch check that flags two same-wave attempts editing the same function — not just the same lines — would have serialized them.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding 5acbce3dc16c85d852f5ac753701216b8fd7acca53d4c14d3c9836ae3fae6757 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-4mv/attempt-43): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/5acbce3dc16c85d852f5ac753701216b8fd7acca53d4c14d3c9836ae3fae6757.json on the run branch.
